summary: plugin/skills/plan/SKILL.md now exists as /vloop:plan, the shell planner ported to vloop's files and commands with kind/area, language, distributed references and the three gate checks on the base; fence/settings.json allows vloop config get, task validate and task gate.

Ran instead go test -count=1 . ./internal/cli ./internal/driver (all ok, which includes TestPluginSkills on the real plugin and the fixture test), gofmt -l . (empty) and go vet ./... (clean). The gate's own checks (example plan validates as a fresh plan, plugin path extraction, fence allow/deny lists) were not run by me.
notes: Port deltas: LOOP_ACTIVE_TASK/LOOP_GATE_TASK became VLOOP_*; .loop/amend.sh check is replaced by vloop schema validate, vloop task validate and vloop task gate; the loop-knowledge.md survey step is replaced by 'distribute only the brief's binding references, never discover' (B-5); the old state shape (status running, run_id set) is replaced by state/v1 with run_id/brief/branch empty for the driver; the 'driver rejects/restores' wording is kept for the stringify, source-text, unreadable-file and fixed-baseline shapes (the driver has gateshape.go for these). Examples that name a denied command were avoided on purpose, because the fence check flags denied commands in code spans. The fence edit only adds allow rules; no deny rule was touched. If the gate fails, the first suspects are the example JSON's fresh-plan jq assertions and the allow-list names.
